programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Samantha, a cheerful freelance journalist, and Jay, an up-and-coming chef from the city, throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a huge run-down country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast -- only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents. The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B&B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. While exploring the evolution of these mammals over the years Aryee also examines how these feline creatures have survived harsh environments, becoming king of the jungle as well as being a popular household pet. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Samantha, a cheerful freelance journalist, and Jay, an up-and-coming chef from the city, throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a huge run-down country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast -- only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents. The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B&B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them.

The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B&B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them.

programme.title: Sangili Bungili Darwaza Khol
programme.desc: Vasu and his mother move into a bungalow they have recently purchased on the outskirts of town. However, they discover the presence of certain supernatural forces.

programme.title: Surya Ka Yaarana
programme.desc: Surya, a soldier going on a rescue mission, hears about his father's death from lung cancer and mournfully looks back on his memories of how he helped him in matters of love and life.

programme.title: Blast Zone
programme.desc: A humble martial arts family faces danger after clashing with a ruthless gang. They must unite to survive the high-stakes battle.

programme.title: The Warrior
programme.desc: After enduring a ruthless gangster's cruelty, a former doctor transforms into a police officer and returns to his city on a quest for justice.

programme.title: Inttelligent
programme.desc: A successful software engineer becomes a vigilante following the demise of his mentor in a bid to seek revenge against those responsible for the latter's death.

programme.title: Bhagavanth Kesari
programme.desc: A former prisoner is adamant about training his adoptive daughter to join the Indian Army. However, his mission is interrupted by a conflict with a ruthless businessman.

programme.title: Veera Simha Reddy
programme.desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.

credits.actor: Nandamuri Balakrishna (Veera Simha Reddy/ Jai Simha Reddy)

programme.title: Veera Simha Reddy
programme.desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.

credits.actor: Nandamuri Balakrishna (Veera Simha Reddy/ Jai Simha Reddy)

programme.title: Gaalodu
programme.desc: After fighting with a villager's son, Raju leaves for the big city, and there he meets Shukla, a nice woman from a rich family. However, this chance meeting could change Raju's life.

programme.title: Aakhri Chaal : Ab kaun bachega
programme.desc: Three brothers conspire against each other in a bid to take over their father's criminal empire following his sudden death. Meanwhile, someone else tries to take advantage of the rift between them.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: DK Bose
programme.desc: DK Bose is a corrupt police officer who conducts himself with confidence and bravado. However, a surprising series of events forces him to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
programme.desc: Bheem and his loyal group of friends embark on a dangerous mission to defeat the evil demon Damyaan and save the world from his villainous plans.

programme.title: Pogaru
programme.desc: A local thug stands up against the atrocities committed on common people and fights to secure justice for them, thus earning the public's respect and affection.

programme.title: Aavesham
programme.desc: After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.

programme.title: Yashoda
programme.desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

programme.title: Devaki Nandana Vasudeva
programme.desc: When a prophecy declares that his nephew will cause his downfall, Kamsaraja becomes worried and stops at nothing to take him down.

programme.title: My Boss Bajrangbali
programme.desc: A corrupt politician kills Anji's parents and plans to demolish a temple. Later, Lord Hanuman takes human form to help Anji fight the politician.

programme.title: Etharkkum Thunindhavan
programme.desc: Kannabiran, a lawyer, saves a young woman from a pornography racket run by Inba, a minister's son. However, Inba threatens to leak explicit videos of several women, making Kannabiran go after him.

programme.title: The Return Of Vaastav
programme.desc: Struggling to get by after serving time for patricide, Nandha finds true love and a new lease on life. However, misadventures soon come knocking on his door once again.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: New power dynamics emerge amongst the survivors of the second ice age when they board a train travelling across the globe.

programme.title: American Made
programme.desc: Barry Seal is a US pilot who smuggles drugs for the CIA in the 1980s. Later, his secret work gets revealed as part of the Iran-Contra scandal.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles team up with their new member, Casey Jones, to take down Shredder, who joins forces with mad scientist Baxter Stockman, Bebop, Rocksteady and Krang.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: An underworld prince ignites a war against humanity to conquer Earth. Consequently, Hellboy and his squad must prevent him from unlocking a lethal army.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: After a genetically altered spider bites him, Peter Parker develops superhuman abilities and confronts a humanoid reptilian creature.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Millie, a high school student, and a serial killer switch bodies when he attacks her with an ancient knife. However, Millie must find a way to reverse the switch before the change becomes permanent.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: A woman is transformed into a lethal post-human weapon after she is forced into a dark underworld deal. She uses her newfound abilities to take revenge on the criminal empire that enslaved her.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: An Egyptologist is caught in the crossfire when a sinister cult resurrects the mummified body of an evil priest. The group then aims to use his ancient power to defeat a legendary warrior.

programme.title: They Call Him OG
programme.desc: An ex-mob boss resurfaces in Mumbai's underworld after a decade, hellbent on seeking revenge against the rival crime lords.

programme.title: IB 71
programme.desc: With limited time to defend the nation from the threat of Pakistan and China ahead of the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, the Intelligence Bureau devises a sophisticated scheme to defy all odds.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A man, drawn to a woman with amnesia, rescues and tries to protect her. However, her past starts resurfacing when a supernatural entity begins to haunt her.

programme.title: Aisa Bhi Hota Hai
programme.desc: During their honeymoon trip to Malaysia, a woman leaves her US-based husband for her lover. Unbeknownst to her, her scorned husband comes across her lover and sets his vengeful plan into motion.

programme.title: Loveyapa
programme.desc: Baani and Gaurav, a young couple, dream of marrying each other. However, in order to approve their union, Baani's father asks them to swap their phones to test their relationship.

programme.title: Pyaar To Hona Hi Tha
programme.desc: Sanjana is desperate to revive her hopeless relationship with Rahul. However, when the brooding and mysterious Shekhar comes along, her heart starts gravitating towards a new possibility.

programme.title: Housefull 5A
programme.desc: After billionaire Ranjeet Dobriyal dies at a party on his luxury cruise ship, several fraudsters pretend to be his son in an attempt to inherit his estate.

programme.title: Welcome
programme.desc: Two thugs meet Rajiv, who belongs to a respectable family, and want to fix their sister's wedding with him. However, when Rajiv's uncle refuses to the match, a series of hilarious situations occur.

programme.title: Welcome Back
programme.desc: Majnu and Uday, a duo of fearsome gangsters, decide to quit the life of crime for good. However, they consider resorting to their old ways when they have difficulty finding a groom for their sister.

programme.title: Dangal
programme.desc: Mahavir Singh Phogat, a former wrestling champion, dedicates himself to transforming his daughters, Geeta and Babita, into elite wrestlers.

programme.title: Godfather
programme.desc: The chief minister's passing wreaks havoc across the state and in his political party. However, a mysterious contender for the post rises to eradicate wrongdoers.

programme.title: Godfather
programme.desc: The chief minister's passing wreaks havoc across the state and in his political party. However, a mysterious contender for the post rises to eradicate wrongdoers.

programme.title: Carry On Jatta 3
programme.desc: Jass, a lawyer's son, is in love with Meet, but the proposal is rejected by his father. However, he strives to win his lover's hand and devises a plan.

programme.title: Gippi
programme.desc: Gippi, an overweight teenager, struggles to handle the physical and social changes that come with her age. Soon, she learns to let go of her insecurities and love herself for exactly who she is.

programme.title: Bal Ganesh And The Pomjom Planet IV
programme.desc: Bal Ganesh's friends accidentally crash-land on a planet named Pomzom, where they are held captive. Bal Ganesh must rush to save his friends.

programme.title: Hungama 2
programme.desc: Vani, Aakash's former lover, returns to him and reveals that he is the father of her child. However, things go awry when he rejects her claim and seeks help from his colleague Anjali.

credits.actor: Rajpal Yadav (Popat Jamal / Raja Dhatingarh Dhingra)

programme.title: Happy New Year
programme.desc: Shuffling between old grudges and new grooves, Charlie and his friends bumble their way through an international dance competition to break into a heavily guarded vault of diamonds.

programme.title: Khatta Meetha
programme.desc: A seemingly corrupt petty contractor faces challenges from the local municipality, his family, his employees, as well as a former girlfriend and her family.

programme.title: Taqdeer
programme.desc: Soon after Avinash manages to get the phone number of his childhood love Priya, his phone gets stolen by a gangster. So, he sets out on a dangerous chase in order to reconcile with his lover.

programme.title: Munjya
programme.desc: When Bittu visits his village, he uncovers a dark family secret involving a vengeful spirit, Munjya, who is desperate to marry. Bittu must navigate through chaos to protect himself and his lover.

programme.title: Maargan
programme.desc: A serial killer targets women with a strange serum that turns their bodies black. Subsequently, a high-ranking police officer sets out to catch the culprit.

credits.actor: Vinod Sagar (Chennai Police ADGP Natraj Pandian IPS)

programme.title: Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari
programme.desc: Heartbroken after their partners, Ananya and Vikram, abandon them to marry each other, Sunny and Tulsi team up to crash the wedding of their former lovers.

programme.desc: Chandan is found dead by his twin brother Trishul, who is a dacoit. In a bid to turn over a new leaf and leave the criminal life behind, Trishul assumes his brother's identity.

programme.title: Kirayadar
programme.desc: When Anil, son of their absentee landlord, arrives in Mumbai and asks them to move out of his home, Laxmi and Jaya's lives turn chaotic.

programme.title: Khel Mohabbat Ka
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Ponga Pandit
programme.desc: Two fathers make arrangements and marry their young children. However, years later when the nuptials are almost finalised, the girl rejects the boy.

programme.title: Lakshmi
programme.desc: Widowed early in life, Lakshmi is forced to turn into a courtesan. However, she strives hard to raise her children under difficult circumstances.

programme.title: Sharmeelee
programme.desc: A man meets a girl at a rest house and falls in love with her. However, on the day of their marriage, he is shocked to be betrothed to her twin sister.

programme.title: Beta Ho To Aisa
programme.desc: When Laxmi's servant is killed, she brings up his son Raju with her own children. When they get involved in some shady dealings, it's up to Raju to sort out the mess his family is in.

programme.title: Kalicharan
programme.desc: When Prabhakar, an honest cop, is murdered by Din Dayal, a powerful crime lord, Khanna recruits his doppelgänger Kalicharan to defeat Din Dayal.

programme.title: Dost
programme.desc: A forest ranger joins hands with locals to prevent large-scale poaching that is prevalent in the nearby forests. However, his efforts infuriate a poaching baron who vows to exact revenge.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Frank's caught wildlife in the Brazilian jungle including a 400 lbs. White Jaguar. He ships it on the same ship as an arrested assassin. The assassin breaks free and frees the animals.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: Megan Fox is a battle-hardened mercenary in the wilds of Africa whose team has rescued hostages from a gang of murderous rebels and is trying to survive - against both the rebels and a pack of ravenous lions.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: Feels Like Hope
programme.desc: As the college fest approaches, Avi and Lakshay are teamed up together which leads to worse consequences for the two of them. Gandhi goes on a journey to find a new passion by participating in the fest, and Sameer pushes himself to face his fear of performing at the fest.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Ruhi needs a new phone and a scholarship, but also wants Lucky’s attention. Kenny wants to stand up for his rights but desperately needs help for the same.

programme.title: The Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Ruhi has second thoughts about her choices. Ayesha needs a story at any cost. Aparna is looking for payback. Meanwhile, Aditya makes some progress with the investigation.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Bhati and Gagan face off in a surprisingly close-fought election. Ruhi has a close shave in an outstation exam. Tarush suffers a setback.

programme.title: Brave New World
programme.desc: Ruhi gets a taste of the good life, briefly, before the shit hits the fan. Tarush takes matters into his own hands. Aparna needs to regain control of her show. Bijoy smells a rat.

programme.title: Vanity Fair
programme.desc: Bhati overcommits to a sponsor and faces a logistical nightmare. Tarush follows the breadcrumbs. Everyone crosses paths at the college festival. Well, almost.

programme.title: The Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: Ayesha looks for missing books. Bijoy starts putting things together. Lucky finds himself in trouble. But Nadeem has bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: The Return of the Native
programme.desc: Lucky comforts a guilt-ridden Ruhi. Aarti makes a shocking discovery. Ayesha takes a trip. Bhati faces unexpected resistance. Gagan opens Aparna’s eyes.

programme.title: Bengaluru Hilaa Denge
programme.desc: Pradeep Bhaiyya, an annoying cousin shows up and takes Akhil and Rinzing for a drunken night. Kay sees Aryan making out. Vasudha, frustrated with her subtly sexist boss, heads out to a new age experience and hooks up with a much younger flute player.

programme.title: Braaazilll!!
programme.desc: Vasudha finally manages to have sex. Akhil is struggling to find his groove at the office, ends up meeting an unconventionally attractive girl, and is blown away. By the end, both Vasu and Akhil confront some seriously painful realities of their lives.

programme.title: Waise Wale Bhai Behen
programme.desc: Vasudha and Akhil forget to tie rakhis to each other on Raksha Bandhan. Vasudha loses her patience with her boss Satvik and impulsively resigns from Proficient. Akhil meets a bizarre therapist. He also finds an unlikely yet intriguing match on Kechup.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow "till death do us part" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in "Happily Never After." It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program "The Doctors," offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. While exploring the evolution of these mammals over the years Aryee also examines how these feline creatures have survived harsh environments, becoming king of the jungle as well as being a popular household pet. Cats are celebrated for their physical prowess, with their running, jumping and climbing skills second to no other animal in the world. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Over two episodes, biologist Patrick Aryee goes on a journey to discover the amazing world of cat species that has spanned over 11 million years. Species featured on the show include caracals jumping to reach their prey, Siberian tigers in their natural landscape and rare footage reveals Bornean bay cats in action.

programme.title: Python Hunters
programme.desc: With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

Each episode features three locations, showcasing the history, geography and traditions of each to help young people gain a better understanding of the diverse world in which they live.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared

programme.title: Ghost Asylum

The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Veteran journalist Paula Zahn steps out of the studio and into the field to unravel criminal investigations, tracking the drama of each story by featuring the opinions of those closest to the case, including law enforcement officials, the families of the victims and the incarcerated, lawyers from both sides, and first-time TV interviews with convicted murderers.

programme.title: Ancient Unexplained Files
programme.desc: Ancient investigations turn tech as specialists harness an advanced digital forensics lab and use the latest scientific discoveries to solve the biggest mysteries of ancient history.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. programme.title: Curse of the Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: Bermuda Triangle is home to some of the most fascinating unsolved mysteries on Earth. This remote territory in the Atlantic Ocean has been the subject of notoriety and legend as countless ships, planes and human lives have been lost in its waters.

programme.title: Ancient Unexplained Files
programme.desc: Ancient investigations turn tech as specialists harness an advanced digital forensics lab and use the latest scientific discoveries to solve the biggest mysteries of ancient history.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Veteran journalist Paula Zahn steps out of the studio and into the field to unravel criminal investigations, tracking the drama of each story by featuring the opinions of those closest to the case, including law enforcement officials, the families of the victims and the incarcerated, lawyers from both sides, and first-time TV interviews with convicted murderers.

programme.title: Ancient Unexplained Files

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Kadukka
programme.desc: In a peaceful village, two best friends find themselves falling for the same girl, turning their friendship into a light-hearted rivalry. As they each try to win her heart in their own quirky ways, unexpected twists and playful misunderstandings add to the chaos. But the girl has a secret that could change everything, leading to a surprising outcome. Interestingly the girl loving the two boys simultaneously and express her love equally to both of them leading to a conflict and the climax is shown with a good interesting suspenseful message.

programme.title: Kanneera
programme.desc: Mithran, a driven and successful CEO, becomes emotionally entangled with his newcomer staff, Neera�though both are already in relationships. Shrisha, Mithran�s partner, prioritizes her career and resists settling down, while Neera�s boyfriend Arun, a pilot, is feeling despondent after losing his job. When Neera hesitates to move abroad for Arun�s new opportunity, their relationship strains, and Mithran�s developing feelings only add to the complexity. Caught in overlapping loyalties, the characters face a maze of emotional dilemmas and moral conflicts.

programme.title: Kaathuvakkula oru kadhal
programme.desc: Maas fights Rathna, who exploits women. Blade plots to kill Maas, but Jeeva dies. Thinking Maas dead, they rejoice�until he returns to face them.

programme.title: Kamu kapi
programme.desc: Ka.Mu � Ka.Pi follows the emotional journey of Anbu and Anu, two colleagues who fall in love and decide to elope, defying their families. Initially, their married life is filled with happiness and hope. But things begin to unravel as Anbu, who dreams of becoming a filmmaker, struggles to find success in the film industry. As financial pressures and emotional stress mount, the couple begins to drift apart. programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. programme.desc: Comment ouvrir une huître ? Steak tartare : faut-il utiliser un hachoir ou un couteau ? Approuvé par des professionnels de renom, François-Régis Gaudry livre d'excellents conseils aux gourmets.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Itinéraire gourmand à travers la France, à la découverte de spécialités gourmandes et des artisans qui perpétuent leurs traditions culinaires. L'occasion de rencontrer un chef de talent pour préparer une recette régionale emblématique.

programme.title: Les quatre coins de l'assiette
programme.desc: On entre dans les coulisses de la cuisine gastronomique canadienne d'un point de vue unique et original. On explore le lien entre un plat créé par un chef de fine cuisine et l'alimentation locale.

programme.title: Les saisons de pique-assiette

programme.title: La cuisine d'Isabelle et Ricardo
programme.desc: La cheffe Isabelle Deschamps Plante poursuit la mission de Ricardo ; elle reçoit dans la même cuisine pour y préparer des recettes simples, réconfortantes et accessibles, trois jours par semaine.

programme.title: C'est plus qu'un jardin
programme.desc: Dans cette série documentaire, deux familles découvrent les joies et les défis de l'autosuffisance. Elles peuvent compter sur Jean-Martin Fortier et Dany Bouchard pour les guider dans la réalisation de leurs projets. On passe de la première pelletée de terre à la préparation à l'hiver, en passant par la plantation, la conservation de l'eau, la construction de nichoirs, la congélation et, finalement, la récolte.

programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.

programme.title: Tevar
programme.desc: A kabaddi player tries to safeguard a young woman hounded by a deadly factional leader who wants to marry her against her wish. Eventually, they both fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Chakravyuh
programme.desc: Kabir infiltrates a Maoist organisation to help Adil Khan, who is a decorated police officer and his friend. As he gets deeper into the organisation, Kabir starts sympathising with the group's plight and starts having second thoughts.

programme.title: Ishk Actually
programme.desc: Gia, a young woman, struggles to cope with the return of Neil, her former lover, and the presence of Kabir, her potential partner.

programme.title: ...Aur Pyar Ho Gaya
programme.desc: Ashi travels to Switzerland to meet the suitor she is supposed to marry. However, in a case of mistaken identity, she meets another man and soon begins to fall for him.

programme.title: Shirin Farhad Ki Toh Nikal Padi
programme.desc: Farhad falls in love with Shirin and introduces her to his mother, but she is dismayed as Shirin is her sworn enemy.

programme.title: Sab Kushal Mangal
programme.desc: Hilarity ensues when the creator of a reality show and his sworn enemy, an unethical politician, become infatuated with the same woman and compete with each other to win her over.

programme.title: Chaalis Chauraasi
programme.desc: Four friends hatch a scheme to steal money by impersonating the police. However, on their way, they run into a real inspector who enlists them to carry out an encounter.

programme.title: RA. One
programme.desc: Hell breaks loose when Ra.One, the powerful antagonist of a video game, takes a physical form and attempts to destroy Shekhar's, the video game designer's, family.

programme.title: Kochadaiiyaan The Legend
programme.desc: Rana, a belligerent warrior, declares war against his kingdom's ruler to avenge his father's death, unexpectedly making a new enemy in the process.

programme.title: Ek Tha Sardaar
programme.desc: Sardaar, a rickshaw driver, leads a content life with his family and is a kind-hearted man. However, his life changes for the worse after he is declared a fugitive.

programme.title: Ek Tha Sardaar
programme.desc: Sardaar, a rickshaw driver, leads a content life with his family and is a kind-hearted man. However, his life changes for the worse after he is declared a fugitive.

programme.title: Rajdhani Express
programme.desc: A man boards a train after he runs away from his criminal boss in hopes starting afresh. His hostility towards the co-passengers brings him under the radar of suspicion and brands him as a terrorist.

programme.title: Daal Mein Kuch Kaala Hai
programme.desc: A young woman, who dreams of becoming a Bollywood star, meets a man who has recently become rich. She then decides to team up with her boyfriend to dupe him.

programme.title: Nanhe Jaisalmer
programme.desc: A young camel jockey befriends a Bollywood superstar on a movie set in Jaisalmer. However, their friendship reaches the verge of destruction after the superstar fails to honour a promise.

programme.title: 3 Bachelors
programme.desc: Two college boys fall into trouble when they tease two girls and, thus, lose their hostel room. Thereafter, they try to find other living quarters, which turns out to be an impossible mission.

programme.title: Main Krishna Hoon
programme.desc: Krishna, an abandoned boy, is taken into an orphanage by a kind couple. When all his friends get adopted and he starts feeling unwanted, Lord Krishna appears and befriends him.

programme.title: Paathshaala
programme.desc: Rahul joins a school as a teacher and instantly strikes a rapport with the children. But he soon realises that the management is more concerned about its monetary benefits rather than the children.

programme.title: Aligarh
programme.desc: Ramchandra Siras, a professor on whom a sting operation is carried out to determine his sexual orientation, forms a special bond with the journalist who covers his story.

programme.title: Phobia
programme.desc: A woman becomes agoraphobic after being assaulted by a taxi driver. She becomes convinced that a malevolent force has taken over the very home in which she is trapped.

programme.title: Desi Boyz
programme.desc: A comedy-drama film about two friends, who lose their jobs during the recession. They decide to become male escorts to make ends meet, hiding their new profession from their families. However, their lives become more complicated when they fall in love and have to deal with the consequences of their new careers. Their lives take a turn when their secret is exposed, leading to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Aa Dekhen Zara
programme.desc: Photographer Ray Acharya, who has not seen much of success considering his potential, inherits a magical camera from his grandfather that transforms his life completely.

programme.title: Haathi Mere Saathi
programme.desc: When a greedy corporation builds a massive township inside a reserve forest, it cuts off vital water access for elephants. Bandev, a dedicated eco-warrior, stands up to protect his habitat.

programme.title: Shakal Pe Mat Ja
programme.desc: Four young filmmakers are arrested at an airport under suspicions of being terrorists. Everything that they say leads them into deeper trouble with the authorities.

programme.title: Kaho Na Kaho
programme.desc: Sikandar, a gangster, develops a strong attachment towards Roshni, who is new to the city. However, when she becomes a famous actress, she falls in love with Raja.

programme.title: Four Two Ka One
programme.desc: Vinay and Raja, two friends and thieves, steal a mysterious bag, hoping it will change their luck. Hilarious events soon ensue and things quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Anwar Ka Ajab Kissa
programme.desc: A strange detective, who overindulges in the lives of his clients, confronts his reality when he is tasked to find Amol.

programme.title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
programme.desc: Harpreet Kaur, a woman who travels to China to find her fiancé, gets mistakenly kidnapped by gangsters whose assignment was to abduct another woman of the same name travelling by the same flight.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: A love expert helps a clumsy man win over his dream girl, only to face unexpected twists when he finds himself entangled in his own complicated romance.

programme.title: Ki & Ka
programme.desc: Kia, an ambitious woman, marries Kabir, a man who prefers the role of a house husband. They enjoy their unconventional relationship until challenges such as ego clashes and jealousy set in.

programme.title: 3G
programme.desc: A young man purchases a new mobile phone before embarking on a holiday with his girlfriend. However, the vacation transforms into a nightmare after he begins receiving mysterious calls from a stranger.

programme.title: Kashmir Daily
programme.desc: After doing thorough research, a reporter strives to bring to light the problems faced by the people of Jammu and Kashmir and showcase their plight with a different viewpoint.

programme.title: Jo Dooba So Paar: It's Love in Bihar!
programme.desc: A school dropout, Keshu, gets smitten with the US-bred Sapna who is visiting Bihar for a college project. However, when Sapna gets kidnapped, Keshu and his motley group of friends decide to help her.

programme.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programme.desc: A group of boys forms a music band and decide to perform publicly in order to make a career. However, they run into problems when their newest member, a girl, wants to change the name of the band.

programme.title: Dekh Tamasha Dekh
programme.desc: The death of a religiously ambiguous man in a rural Indian town leads to tensions between two factions of the Hindu and Muslim communities over the body.

programme.title: Buddha Mar Gaya

programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: Mahinder, a gangster, hires Munna, a street dancer, to train him so that he can impress his lady-love, Dolly. However, when Dolly goes missing, Munna vows to bring her back.

programme.title: Khajoor Pe Atke
programme.desc: When Devinder Sharma, a middle-class man, ends up in the ICU, hilarity ensues as his relatives turn up from all over the country.

programme.title: Hum Tumhare Hain Sanam
programme.desc: Gopal is happily married to Radha until she meets her friend Suraj and starts obsessing over his singing career. Gopal suspects that they are secretly seeing each other and decides to leave her.

programme.desc: When Kamala's marriage is called off due to lack of dowry, Ananda saves her reputation by marrying her. Later, he abandons her on realising that she is unable to read and write.

programme.title: Bagh Bandi Khela
programme.desc: An anthology of three stories of individuals who react differently to crime and face unexpected consequences as a result of their actions.

programme.title: Ami Je Ke Tomar
programme.desc: Aditya, a commitment-phobic hotelier, loves Esha, his innocent employee. Things get complicated when Esha's past comes to the fore, and he realises that Prachi, his associate, loves him.

programme.title: One
programme.desc: An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.

programme.title: Bony
programme.desc: A couple living in Milan, Italy, have a child together. However, their child has some special powers and a scientist on the run from the police is in search of the infant.

programme.title: Highway
programme.desc: Sohini, a Bengali woman, gets married to Ashwin, a man from another community. When they feel lost in their lives, they decide to understand each other's perspectives.

programme.title: Jongole Mitin Mashi
programme.desc: A detective is assigned the responsibility of investigating a gang of poachers suspected of illegally hunting wild elephants in the forest.

programme.title: Action
programme.desc: Raka, the daughter of an influential politician, always gets what she desires. However, all hell breaks loose when she is rejected by Akash, a fellow college student.

programme.title: Sarkar Colony
programme.desc: Shivaramakrishnan is a government employee who struggles to make ends meet. In order to earn some quick money, he and his friends start a daycare centre, which proves to be even more disastrous.

programme.title: Acha Dhin
programme.desc: While looking to borrow money to meet his wife's medical expenses, Durgaprasad uncovers a deadly terrorist plot and must act to save the city from destruction.

programme.title: Novel
programme.desc: Sethunath is a successful writer who shares the story of his life with journalist Aneesa. He talks about falling in love with Priya and his inability to marry her because of his estranged wife, Manju.

programme.title: Action Hero Biju
programme.desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

programme.title: Love Action Drama
programme.desc: Dinesh, a conceited and wealthy young bachelor, goes to extreme lengths to impress a girl named Shobha with the help of his best friend Sagar, and Dinesh eventually hopes to marry Shobha.

programme.title: Ohm Shanthi Oshaana
programme.desc: Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, dreams about marrying only for love. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.

programme.title: Oru Vadakkan Selfie
programme.desc: When his father asks him to manage their grocery store, Umesh runs away to Chennai to become a film-maker. His life changes after he takes a selfie with his old neighbour and posts it online.

programme.title: Premam
programme.desc: While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.

programme.title: Sakhavu
programme.desc: Kichu is a heartless student leader who can go to any extent for power. He is asked to donate his blood to save a man named Krishnan, whose story changes him for the better.

programme.title: Sakhavu
programme.desc: Kichu is a heartless student leader who can go to any extent for power. He is asked to donate his blood to save a man named Krishnan, whose story changes him for the better.

programme.title: Parthan Kanda Paralokam
programme.desc: Parthasarathy is well-loved by the people around him as he constantly works for their welfare. Soon, he falls in love with the daughter of his rival, unaware that she has an ulterior motive.

programme.title: Seelabathi
programme.desc: Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.

programme.title: Thaskara Lahala
programme.desc: Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.

programme.title: Theerppu
programme.desc: Four friends with a traumatic history reunite at a resort. All hell breaks loose when the group encounters unanticipated repercussions from their past.

programme.title: Vismayam
programme.desc: Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.

programme.title: Traffic

programme.title: Minnal Murali

programme.title: Sadirsha Vakyam 24:29

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Street racing in the US is the subject of this docu-reality series, which purportedly provides an inside look into the action both on the road and behind the scenes. In Oklahoma City, for example, racers boast having the fastest street cars in the country, and the racing, they say, comes first - before family, before friends and before work. From a 1969 Chevy Nova to a race-ready farm truck, the vehicles - and their drivers - come in all shapes and sizes and have one thing in common: the need for speed.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.desc: Born out of a passion for classic Japanese vehicles, Eric Bizek founded JDM Legends in Salt Lake City in 2009. programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

Each location comes alive in never-before-seen footage showing the unique connectedness of the land that millions of people call home.

programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Asia
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough presents Asia, a seven-part series covering the length and breadth of our planet's largest and richest continent, revealing its most remarkable landscapes and animals, and stories featuring dramatic, previously unseen behaviour. Filmed over the course of nearly four years, this is the first time that Asia has been the focus of a landmark BBC wildlife series. From the vast Gobi Desert, to the jungles of Borneo, and from the polar wilderness of Siberia to the coral seas of the Indian Ocean, this series will showcase the breath-taking variety of Asia's wildest places.
